title: Late Charge Added to a HomeFlood Closing Payment
content:
**Rule.** A late charge is added to the closing payment on a cancelled HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy when an installment is overdue. Its size depends on how far the overdue installment is past its due date on the payment date, counted in calendar days.

| Overdue installment, on the payment date | Late charge |
|---|---|
| more than 30 days past its due date | 2 percent of the overdue installment's later-installment share |
| past its due date by 30 days or fewer | a flat 10 USD |
| no installment overdue | none |

**Later-installment share.** For this charge, the overdue installment's later-installment share is 20 percent of the term's term premium item.

**The overdue installment.** The overdue installment is the installment of the latest installment fee booked on the term, when no payment with that installment number was received for the term; when that latest installment was paid, no installment is overdue. An installment's due date is the posted date of its installment fee, which is booked on the day the installment falls due under the plan. Where several installment fees share the latest posted date, the one recorded first counts.

**The payment date.** The payment date is the day the customer makes the closing payment, and every length of time counted to the payment date ends on that day.

## Hypothetical cases

- **More than 30 days.** A term premium item of 1,500.00 gives a later-installment share of 300.00. An overdue installment 41 days past due carries a late charge of 2 percent of 300.00, that is 6.00.
- **Within 30 days.** The same installment 12 days past due carries 10.00.
- **Latest installment paid.** When the latest installment fee's installment number already has a payment for the term, no installment is overdue and no charge applies.

| Days past due | Charge |
|---|---|
| 30 | 10.00 flat |
| 31 | 2 percent of the share |
